title: AI in Everyday Life
introduction: Many familiar digital services use AI quietly to rank, predict, recognise or generate information.
learningOutcomes: Recognise several everyday uses of AI.
Explain the role of predictions in familiar applications.
Distinguish generative AI from systems that classify or rank.

activities.question: What does a recommendation system usually predict?
options: Which items a person may find relevant
The exact thoughts of every user
Whether the internet is made of physical roads
Only the alphabetical order of items
activities.explanation: Recommendation systems estimate relevance from signals such as previous choices and similarities between items.

activities.question: Complete the sentence: A system that creates new text or images is called ___ AI.
activities.explanation: Generative AI produces new content based on patterns learned during training.
